blocks.text: Sullivan Station homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Sullivan Station, September 2026. Detached houses: 93 listed at month end and 6 sold in September, a sales ratio of 6% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 128 listed at month end and 10 sold in September, a sales ratio of 8% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 29 sold over 4 months against an average of 92.0 listed, about 12.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 11 sold. Condos and townhomes: 84 sold over 4 months against an average of 132.8 listed, about 6.3 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 34 sold.

faq.q: Which schools are in the Sullivan area?
faq.a: Sullivan Elementary (6016 152 St), Cambridge Elementary (6115 150 St), Goldstone Park Elementary (6287 146 St), Woodward Hill Elementary (6082 142 St) and the new École Snokomish Elementary (14778 58B Ave, opened January 2026), with Sullivan Heights Secondary (6248 144 St) for Grades 8–12 — but the assigned school for a specific address is set through the SD36 School Locator, and no catchment is asserted here without a locator run.

faq.q: What plan governs Sullivan Station now?
faq.a: The Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan and Zoning Bylaw No. 12000. The South Newton plan that covered this ground was rescinded by the Surrey 2050 OCP update and is no longer in effect.

faq.q: How did the Sullivan Station market do in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached: 93 listings, 6 sales, 6% sales ratio. Attached (condos & townhomes): 128 listings, 10 sales, 8% sales ratio. Surrey-wide medians that month were $1,215,000 detached and $512,944 attached (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Can a Sullivan Station house lot add units?
faq.a: Within Surrey's SSMUH framework — up to 3 units on lots under 280 m², 4 units on lots over 280 m², and 6 units on eligible lots of 281 m² or more within 400 m of a frequent bus stop; one secondary suite per house is permitted under the BC Building Code.

faq.q: Is there a new school in Sullivan?
faq.a: Yes — École Snokomish Elementary, 14778 58B Ave, a 27-classroom, 655-seat K–7 school, opened in January 2026 for students from the Cambridge, Goldstone Park, Sullivan and Woodward Hill catchments, inheriting Woodward Hill's French Immersion program.
